annotation_method: manual visual inspection of original face and YuNet eye crops
label_rule: Open: visible iris/aperture; Closed: eyelid shut; Unknown: uncertain, occluded or too blurred. Source smile/yawn labels do not determine eye labels.
subject_independence: NOT established; adjacent frames can share subjects/clips across legacy splits
